finding.summary: Newly lexable unbounded refs are not integrated with existing reference-rewriting machinery (`shiftFormula`/`shiftSref`, autofill/copy-paste adjustment)
finding.evidence: packages/sheets/src/index.ts exports `shiftSref`, `shiftFormula`, `shiftDimensionMap`, which rewrite REFERENCE tokens when rows/columns are inserted or deleted. After this grammar change, `A:A`, `1:1`, `A1:B` lex as REFERENCE tokens and will flow into those code paths, which parse endpoints with the full-ref assumption (`parseRef`). Neither the diff nor docs/design/sheets/formula.md mentions how unbounded refs survive row/column insert-delete, fill-handle, or copy/paste reference adjustment; only `extractFormulaRanges` is called out as a limitation. A partially-supported syntax that corrupts on structural edits is a fit gap for the feature.
